newsitem.title: USA: Georgia-Pacific sued by mill for $7.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Georgia-Pacific sued by mill for $7.9 mln.

text.p: A Multnomah County jury awarded the owners of a Toledo saw mill $7.9 million in its breach of contract lawsuit against Georgia-Pacific Corp and two of its employees, Northwest Strategies Inc said.
Speaking on behalf of Newport Land & Timber, Northwest said the jury also found that the company was liable for $7.5 million in punitive damages.
Newport, the mill's owner and operator, alleged that Georgia-Pacific promised it a steady flow of log supplies but then cut them off when it became interested in buying the mill.
It said the cut off forced the mill to close last year and lay off 50 workers. The mill has not reopened.
Georgia-Pacific officials were not available for comment.
